scope: Data-only validation after an outer execution session returned 143 and its wrapper receipt was absent; no new scientific evaluation or changed thresholds.
facts: Zoom log continued after the outer session exit and all 24 frames plus complete zoom_metrics.json were written. The wrapper did not write ZOOM_EXECUTION.json. Preserve SESSION_FAILURE.json and all original files.
validation: Verify frozen source/input hashes and prior seal again
Check all 60 full-image pixels against prior frames
Recompute every saved sample-to-same-ID distance and offset for baseline/drift/drop from saved raster-support pixels
Verify actual saved no-wrap drift rasters, targeted drops and mutually exclusive coverage/event denominators
Keep finite-distance and detected-pair conditional denominators in pooled descriptive summaries
Bind validation source and completed evidence hashes before running validation
allowed_outcome: If all validation passes, science data can be complete while the outer session return 143 and unknown child return code remain explicit. Otherwise keep engineering_invalid. No re-render or replacement metrics.
nonclaim: Successful data validation is not evidence of a successful original process exit.
